description: Blender-like tool-inspector: make the ACTIVE tool an explicit, legible UI MODE — a tool-mode switcher (top) + a left per-tool inspector panel (Use/Settings zones) that reshapes how Select/Move/Rotate/Scale/Pen behave, surfaces each mode's affordances (gimbal-active, axis constraints, snapping, highlighting), without merging the two selection authorities and without an fe-ui->fe-terrain dependency
